plan.source_support: 靠近热源时，外侧鞋面会优先升温、优先变干；但鞋头深部、鞋垫下方及内衬与中底之间的区域，仍可能保留较高湿度。表面已经干燥，并不代表整双鞋的含水量已降到适合穿着的水平。
plan.intent: show why a dry surface does not prove a dry shoe interior
plan.source_slice: 干燥的核心，是水分迁移而非表面升温
plan.beat: surface dryness versus retained internal moisture
plan.previous_handoff: the agenda establishes that moisture migration is the first reading beat
plan.next_bridge: once moisture is understood as unevenly distributed, the next frame examines uneven heat exposure
plan.reader_block: 读者应能判断：外层变干不能证明鞋内已干透。
plan.source_relation: the outer upper dries before the deep toe, under-insole area, and lining-to-midsole region
plan.subtitle: 表层先干，深处仍可能潮湿
comparison_basis: the outer upper is dry while three deep interior zones retain moisture marks
the shoe structure visibly separates the dry exterior from the wet interior
plan.visual_solution: One lightly-oblique sneaker in a shallow flat cutaway: a pale dry outer textile shell encloses three compact gray moisture marks at the toe cavity, under-insole pocket, and lining-to-midsole seam. The collar is slightly open and one insole edge is lifted but remains connected to the shoe opening. Use one translucent uneven brand-green wax-pencil gesture only along one internal seam, plus an irregular cluster of moisture marks.
must_show: a dry outer textile shell is separate from deeper interior zones
the toe cavity, beneath-insole pocket, and lining-to-midsole seam retain visible moisture marks
the intact cutaway makes the two conditions legible without the title
must_not_imply: that heat is the only cause of retained moisture

local_colours.rationale: local reading emphasis for the hidden interior zone

visible_evidence: the pale outer shell contrasts structurally with three inner moisture-marked pockets
the cutaway and lifted insole make the hidden locations readable without title text

continuity_rules: the shoe remains one complete connected object
the partially lifted insole remains attached to the same shoe opening

plan.source_support: 贴近暖气或热风出口时，受热侧与背阴侧会形成明显温差。织物、合成革、EVA 等泡棉材料、橡胶和胶黏层会以不同速度升温和形变；当温度分布不均且持续时间较长时，鞋面起皱、泡棉局部收缩、鞋型偏移或粘接界面性能下降的风险都会增加。
plan.intent: show the contrast between unevenly heated and shaded sides of one composite shoe
plan.source_slice: 局部高温会放大材料之间的热梯度
plan.beat: uneven temperature exposure creates different material responses
plan.previous_handoff: the preceding frame shows that a shoe's interior does not dry uniformly
plan.next_bridge: the final practical frame shifts from the risk of uneven heat to an airflow-based drying sequence
plan.reader_block: 读者应能判断：局部高温造成的两侧温差，会放大复合材料不同步升温与形变的风险。
plan.source_relation: the heated side and shaded side form a temperature contrast while textile, foam, rubber, and adhesive layers respond at different speeds
plan.core_judgment: 局部热，不等于均匀干燥
plan.subtitle: 温差会放大材料不同步反应
comparison_basis: the heated side has compact rising heat marks while the shaded side remains unmarked
the upper, foam midsole, rubber outsole, and adhesive seam visibly respond as separate connected layers
plan.visual_solution: One complete side-profile sneaker is divided by a quiet vertical boundary into a source-supported heated side and shaded side. On the heated side, three short restrained gray heat marks approach the upper; the upper has a small wrinkle, the foam midsole has one local inward pinch, and the upper-to-sole adhesive seam is visibly stressed but remains connected. The shaded side remains smooth and unmarked. Use shallow flat-cutaway layers, a broad slightly tilted silhouette, one uneven translucent brand-green wax-pencil fill on the stressed seam region, and no heater, fan, numeric scale, or detached parts.
must_show: a visibly heated side and a visibly shaded side are separated across one shoe
the upper, foam midsole, rubber outsole, and adhesive seam remain distinct connected layers
the heated side alone shows a wrinkle, local foam pinch, and stressed seam
must_not_imply: that any one material will always fail
a brand-specific test or appliance recommendation

local_colours.rationale: local reading emphasis for the source-supported stress zone

visible_evidence: the heat-marked side and unmarked shaded side are structurally different before labels are read
the connected upper, foam, outsole, and seam show locally different reactions only on the heated side

continuity_rules: the shoe remains one connected side-profile object
the upper, midsole, outsole, and seam stay connected despite visible local stress

plan.source_support: 更稳妥的处理顺序是：先取出鞋垫，松开鞋带并拉开鞋舌；用干毛巾轻压鞋内可见积水，避免反复扭拧鞋面或中底；随后将鞋放在阴凉、干燥且空气流动的位置，使空气能够从鞋口进入，并带走蒸发出的水汽。
plan.intent: show the source-supported drying sequence that avoids local high heat
plan.source_slice: 先降低自由水，再建立稳定的通风路径
plan.beat: open the structure, absorb visible water, then keep air flowing
plan.previous_handoff: the previous frame establishes why uneven heat creates material risk
plan.next_bridge: the closing leaves the audience with the complete non-heating drying path
plan.reader_block: 读者应能按顺序先打开结构、再吸除可见水分、最后让空气穿过鞋内。
plan.source_relation: open the shoe structure, absorb visible water, then establish airflow through the shoe opening
plan.subtitle: 先减少自由水，再维持气流
plan.visual_solution: One intact shoe system unfolds across three small ordered states in a calm asymmetric cluster: first, a shoe with loosened laces, lifted tongue, and its insole directly beside its opening; second, the same shoe receives one folded dry towel pressing only visible pooled water at the opening; third, the same shoe receives sparse ordinary airflow through the collar, carrying small vapor marks away. Use shallow flat-cutaway views, a broad slightly tilted silhouette, connected objects only, and one small uneven brand-green wax-pencil fill on the opened tongue edge.
must_show: the insole is removed and the laces and tongue are opened
a dry towel presses visible water without twisting the shoe
air enters through the collar and carries vapor away after excess water is absorbed
must_not_imply: a powered drying device or tightly stuffed towel

local_colours.rationale: local reading emphasis for the opened structure

visible_evidence: three ordered shoe states are linked left to right by two restrained directional lines
the state changes are visibly opened, towel-pressed, and ventilated

continuity_rules: each state shows one intact connected shoe
the insole appears only as the intentionally removed component beside the first state
